facts.claim: B2B SaaS monthly ARPU runs 20 to 50 dollars self-serve, 50 to 200 for SMB, 200 to 2,000 mid-market and 2,000 to 10,000 plus for enterprise
facts.source_title: ARPU Benchmarks 2026: Where Does Your SaaS Rank
facts.excerpt: Self-serve products land at $20-50/month, SMB at $50-200, mid-market at $200-2,000, and enterprise at $2,000-10,000+/month.

facts.claim: The 2026 median B2B SaaS ARPU is about 250 dollars a month, up from 210 in 2024
facts.source_title: ARPU Benchmarks 2026: Where Does Your SaaS Rank
facts.excerpt: The 2026 median B2B SaaS ARPU is approximately $250/month, up from $210/month in 2024.

facts.claim: Median SMB SaaS ARPU is 55 dollars a month
facts.source_title: ARPU Benchmarks 2026: Where Does Your SaaS Rank
facts.excerpt: For SMB specifically, the median ARPU is $55.

facts.claim: SaaS segments are defined by annual contract value: SMB under 10,000 dollars, mid-market 10,000 to 100,000, enterprise above 100,000
facts.source_title: B2B SaaS Churn Rate Benchmarks, 939 Companies by Segment and ACV
facts.excerpt: Segments are defined by ACV: SMB under $10K, Mid-Market $10K-$100K, Enterprise above $100K.

facts.claim: SMB products under 15,000 dollars ACV carry 2,000 to 8,000 dollars of CAC, and mid-market products from 15,000 to 100,000 ACV carry 15,000 to 40,000
facts.excerpt: SMB products with ACVs under $15,000 have CAC of $2,000 to $8,000; mid-market targeting $15,000 to $100,000 has median CAC of $15,000 to $40,000.

facts.claim: Annual account churn runs a 15% median for SMB, 10% for mid-market and 5% for enterprise
facts.source_title: B2B SaaS Churn Rate Benchmarks, 939 Companies by Segment and ACV
facts.excerpt: Annual account churn rates by segment: SMB median 15 percent, Mid-Market 10 percent, Enterprise 5 percent.

facts.claim: Gross revenue retention by contract size runs 82% under 25,000 dollars ACV, 88% from 25,000 to 100,000, and 95% above
facts.excerpt: SMB (<$25K ACV): 82% GRR; Mid-Market ($25K-$100K): 88% GRR; Enterprise (>$100K ACV): 95% GRR.
